context:
Goal: sessions start without the app's "Allow Claude to start the session?" card on every start, and no check is silently lost.
Problem (rule): the round-3 reviewer judged the net safety value of PR 3381 negative, so the change is parked until you accept the loss or name another route (rule roles-review-cap-three). It does what your ruling own-809-reopen-hook-card (00:12 CST Nov 14) asked: it takes mcp__ccd_session__start_session out of the PreToolUse matcher, because that matcher makes the app show the card on every start, even in Bypass (anthropics/claude-code#103832), and adds a PostToolUse audit.
Based on (read): the PR body and the review record 6890835699 on head cdb68f8d8d6a (Round 1 haiku PASS, Round 2 sonnet FAIL, Round 3 sonnet PASS, Fix check PASS, Net value negative; lane lint PASS 6891045068). Triage read the PR on GitHub at 01:26 CST: open draft, head cdb68f8d8d6a, mergeable clean, 16 files, 11 commits; the coordinator's relay matches. Triage did not read the record or the lint comment.
Based on (read): lost at the gate, per the PR body: the model floor and the handoff-unread check on a start are now flag-only after the call (debt start-session-checks-after); the full-machine load brake on a start is gone (debt start-session-load-unbraked).
Based on (unmeasured): the app code path is your own reading, and the Bypass test on the desktop app is still unrun (item 809 stays open until it runs).
Departs from: main refuses a below-floor start and a start with the handoff unread, and brakes a start under load; this change flags the first two after the start and drops the brake. Option a turns two main refusals into after-the-fact flags and removes one brake, which is a loss of safety checks; the coordinator recommends it because you chose the card's removal and the change can be reverted.
Meanwhile: runner 10 does not take the PR; the lane waits. Item 809 (the reopened card question) stays open for your Bypass test. Two lane notes, filed on the step, not asked: the audit tells an agent caller to use interrupt and archive tools that the guard refuses for agents; the start_session lane tag is unmeasured. docs/records.md is not committed (a lane may not); hook_catalog --check is red only on it.
Coordinator's recommendation: option a. No other session recommended an option.
Owner answered a at 01:43 CST Nov 15 (his word "a", relayed by the consultant at 01:43 CST). Filed as ruling own-3381-a; the load brake on a start is the follow-up step start-checks-after-call.
